mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmarks (user_id, blog_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{blogId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blog_id = #{blogId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blog_id = #{blogId} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.content, b.author_id, u.username as author_name, u.avatar_url as author_avatar, b.category, b.series_id, s.name as series_name, b.view_count, b.scheduled_at, b.status, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM bookmarks bk JOIN blogs b ON bk.blog_id = b.id LEFT JOIN users u ON b.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN series s ON b.series_id = s.id WHERE bk.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bk.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId}
